prompt:
Image 1 is the camera and pose guide: a grey clay maquette rendered from the game's battle camera, with the cape painted in the god's colour. Copy from it exactly the camera angle, the direction the figure faces, its pose, and its size and place in the frame. Do not copy its smooth clay surfaces, its simplified shapes or the thickness of its limbs: the anatomy, the face and every ornament follow Image 2 and the description.
Image 2 is this god's own approved painted portrait: paint the same figure, with the same shapes, colours, materials and marks, now seen full length from above at the battle camera, in the same painting style. Do not copy its dark background, its candlelight or its framing.

One large painted figure, full length, alone in the image on a perfectly flat, uniform pure green (#00FF00) background, as a game cutout. Pose: standing at rest, the straight sword held upright before the chest in the right hand, the left hand at the side, the long cape hanging from both shoulders.

Camera: high above and in front, looking down at about 40 degrees, the way a player looks down at a miniature on a table; orthographic, with no perspective. The figure faces toward us and toward the lower left of the image: we see its face from above, its chest and its left side. It is foreshortened as seen from above: the top of its head, its shoulders and its upper body are large, its legs short.

Light: outdoor daylight; the figure stays as dark and as muted as in its portrait, lit only by small warm and cool highlights, never washed out or brightened. A high sun in the upper left of the image lights the top of the head, the upper surfaces and the upper-left side of the figure with warm highlights; a cool blue-grey sky fill lies in the shadows on the lower-right side. No candlelight, no dramatic dark shadows, nothing glows unless the description below says so. No cast shadow on the background.

Painting style: painterly oil on a wood panel, visible directional brushwork, moderate detail, the same hand as the painted portrait; a muted earthy palette with the god's own colours as its portrait shows them, in which the cape in dull ember-orange (#C4532C), the Cinder Horde's colour is the one clear hue; soft painterly edges, with small crisp highlights on metal edges and a thin bright rim of light along the upper-left edges of the figure. The figure has a strong, simple, readable silhouette that still reads when it is shrunk to 120 pixels tall. It is not a cartoon: no cel shading, no thick black outlines, no chibi or big-headed proportions, no glossy 3D render, no pixel art.

The god: the Ascended Hero, a mortal champion raised to godhood: a lean warrior a head taller than a man, ageless and noble. Colours: muted and earthy. The one clear colour of the figure is its long cape: dull ember-orange cloth (#C4532C), the Cinder Horde's colour. All metal is dull old gold (#C9A23E), darkened and worn. Nothing in the image glows. No other saturated area larger than a small clasp or trim.
Headgear: a simple circlet of dull old gold (#C9A23E), darkened and worn around the brow, no helm; short dark hair. Face: a lean, calm, ageless face of ash-grey skin (#8F8C88), steady eyes. Armour: a coat of dark mail under a fitted breastplate of dark steel trimmed with old gold, plain, with no heraldry and no device; dark leather boots. Mantle: a long cape of dull ember-orange cloth (#C4532C), the Cinder Horde's colour falling from both shoulders to the heels, its edge bordered with a narrow lichen grey-green (#909080) band. Weapon: a straight one-handed sword with a plain straight blade and a gold crossguard. Proportions: tall and heroic, a towering figure with long legs (the legs about half of its height) and the head about one eighth of its height; never squat, stocky, short-legged or dwarf-like.

Size: the figure fills about 86% of the image along its longest side, placed as in Image 1, with at least 24 pixels of clean background all around; nothing is cropped.

Background: one flat pure green (#00FF00) colour fills the whole image with no gradient, texture, floor, vignette or shadow. No green anywhere on the figure: no green cloth, no green glow, no green reflections; any lichen grey-green trim stays a pale grey.

Never: text, letters, numbers, labels, grid lines, borders, frames, signatures, logos; a floor, ground, scenery or cast shadows; blood; other creatures or people; a cropped figure; smoke, flames, sparks, floating embers or mist.
